lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay, I think we're all here. Thanks for joining, both of you. This is our last check-in before the checkout launch, so let's keep it short.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sounds good, Maya. Quick update from my side: the new checkout works on every phone we tested, except one thing. Apple Pay still fails on older iPhones.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: How long would it take to fix that?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Honestly, at least a week. Apple has to review the change, and that's out of our hands.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Then I'd launch without Apple Pay. Card payments work fine, and we can add Apple Pay in the next release.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I agree. Daniel, are you okay with that?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, that works for me. I'll hide the Apple Pay button for now.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Great. So we ship on Thursday, with cards only. Priya, how is the design side looking?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Almost done. The only screen left is the empty cart. Right now it just says zero items, which feels a bit cold. I'll add a short line and a button back to the shop.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Can you have that ready by Wednesday, so Daniel can still build it in?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: One more thing. The delivery address field still drops the apartment number when you paste an address. I'll fix that tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good catch. Customers would hate that. Okay, then on my side, I'll write to our twenty beta testers on Friday and ask how the new checkout feels.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Could you ask them about the empty cart too? I'd love to know if the new line helps.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure, I'll add that question. Anything else before we wrap up?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Perfect. So: launch on Thursday without Apple Pay. Daniel fixes the address field tomorrow and hides the button. Priya finishes the empty cart by Wednesday morning. And I email the beta testers on Friday. Thanks, everyone!
